newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lovesick German builder lands in jail.
newsitem.headline: Lovesick German builder lands in jail.

text.p: A lovesick German construction worker drove a 4.5 tonne excavator into the bedroom window of his ex-girlfriend in the middle of the night in an unsuccessful bid to win her back, a German newspaper reported on Saturday.

The 34-year-old man drove the power shovel more than 20 km (12 miles) to his girlfriend's house in Kerpen just north of Bonn. Ilona Vogel was quoted by the Cologne Express daily as telling him he was drunk and should come back when he was sober.

He then climbed back onto the excavator, demolished a 12-metre long fence in front of her house, and rammed her bedroom window with the raised shovel. Police arrested the man about an hour later. His employer fired him, the paper said.
